title: Pre-flight prints the same guider problem twice and both times tells you to connect PHD2, in a build that ships its own native guider
what_happened: The General section lists 'No Guider Connected - This sequence includes guiding or dithering operations that require PHD2' immediately followed by 'Guider Not Connected - Dither requires a guider (PHD2) but none is connected.' Both carry the identical hint 'Connect to PHD2 in the Guiding panel.' Discovery in this same build offers a 'Built-in Multi-Star Guider (native)' with no PHD2 involved.
expected: One warning per distinct problem, and advice that matches the guider backends this build actually offers.
repro: Build any sequence containing a Dither node with no guider connected, press Start, scroll the Pre-Flight dialog.
where: Sequencer > Builder > Start > Pre-Flight Validation > General
proposed_fix: De-duplicate the two rules and make the remediation text backend-aware ('Connect a guider in Equipment, or PHD2 in the Guiding panel').

title: Node palette search ranks Smart Exposure above the node literally named 'Dither' when you search 'Dither'
what_happened: Typing 'Dither' in the node palette search returns 'Smart Exposure' first (its description contains 'handles rotation + dither') and the node actually named 'Dither' second. Clicking the first result's + - the natural action after typing an exact node name - adds a Smart Exposure node instead. I hit this myself: the sequence silently gained an unwanted Smart Exposure node (visible only as the planned-frame count jumping from 4 to 8).
expected: An exact name match ranks first. NINA's instruction search puts a literal name match at the top.
proposed_fix: Score name matches above description matches; exact/prefix name match first.

title: Continue Session reports '0 minutes integration' for a session that has 12s of integration on the card behind it
what_happened: The dialog's Progress row reads '4/4 frames captured, 0 minutes integration'. The dashboard card for the same run reads '12s integration'. Integration time is rounded to whole minutes, so any sub-minute (and any 90s) session is reported as 0 or as a truncated value.
expected: Match the rest of the app: '12s integration'. Reporting real captured photons as '0 minutes' is the sort of thing that makes a user think the run did nothing.
repro: Run a short sequence (4 x 3s), relaunch, read the Continue Session Progress row and compare with the dashboard's last-run card.
where: App launch > Continue Session > Progress row
proposed_fix: Use the same duration formatter as the dashboard card (h/m/s), not integer minutes.

title: A node can only be reordered by drag; the node context menu offers just Duplicate and Delete
what_happened: After adding Unpark Mount late (it appended to the end, after Take Exposures) the only way to move it earlier is drag-and-drop: right-clicking the node yields a popup menu containing exactly two items, 'Duplicate' and 'Delete' (accessibility tree: 'panel: Popup menu / button: Duplicate / button: Delete'). There is no Move Up / Move Down / Cut / Paste, and no keyboard equivalent. My drag attempt (press, 9 intermediate moves, release over the target row) left the order unchanged.
expected: Move up / move down (or cut+paste) in the context menu, as NINA and SGP both provide. Order is semantically load-bearing here - unpark must precede slew - and a sequence with 30 instructions is not comfortably reordered by dragging in a scrolling tree.
repro: Sequencer > Builder > add any node > right-click it > read the menu.
proposed_fix: Add Move Up / Move Down / Indent / Outdent to the context menu and bind them to Alt+Arrow.
